title: Matrix representations and arithmetic properties of jacobsthal numbers via binary 3x3 matrices
summary: We study matrix representations of the Jacobsthal sequence generated by binary 3x3 matrices with determinants 0, 2, and -2, using linear algebraic methods analogous to Fibonacci-type constructions. Explicit formulas for matrix powers are obtained, yielding identities for Jacobsthal numbers, including convolution formulas, trace relations, determinant expressions, and Cassini-type identities. We further derive congruence relations and recurrence formulas, and analyze arithmetic properties such as partial sums and the Sidon-type structure of the sequence.
